events.verdict: McCollum (POR) makes body to body contact with Dragic (MIA) prior to his upward shooting motion.
Crowder (MIA) makes slight contact with Whiteside (POR) during the rebound.
After the pick, Iguodala (MIA) continues to move into and affects Ariza's (POR) FOM.
Ariza (POR) is firming up and makes marginal contact with Iguodala (MIA) during the pick.
Adebayo (MIA) cleanly dislodges the basketball, any additional contact to Whiteside's (POR) arm is deemed incidental.
Adebayo (MIA) sets the screen on Ariza (POR) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
McCollum (POR) legally contests Dragic's (MIA) jump shot attempt. Any "high-five" contact after the release is considered incidental.
Crowder (MIA) maintains a legal guarding position and cleanly blocks Lillard's (POR) shot attempt.
Crowder (MIA) has a resting hand on Lillard's (POR) body during his shot attempt.
Adebayo (MIA) is firming up and sets the pick on Ariza (POR), the two make marginal contact with one another as they disengage from the pick.
Lillard (POR) makes some contact with Robinson (MIA) after he extends his leg unnaturally on his follow through.
Adebayo (MIA) commits a take foul on Whiteside (POR).
McCollum (POR) dislodges Crowder (MIA), affecting his ability to retrieve the rebound.
